title: The Orchard of Maple Hollow
author: Dominic Almeida
blurb: Beatrix Nystrom, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
